scopeLimitation: Only the frozen URL/device inventory is measured; deliberate404 contracts and nonindexable auth/offline documents are separate from indexable content.

attemptHistory.note: Reservation-only files do not claim a measured outcome. Original process outcomes use sourceStatus when export validation refused a report; refusals are separate and are not additional Lighthouse failures. All reported attempts remain retained.

failedAuditEvidence.note: Missing audit evidence is reported explicitly and does not mean there were no failed audits. Expected noindex/HTTP-denial outcomes are separate from optimization or review findings; a sub-perfect metric audit is not by itself a functional failure.
